summary: Returns tags list and description for each artist.
description: Returns the tags list of each artist together with its HTML description (if present). All common parameters of the parent 'artists' endpoint are supported, plus a 'tag' filter (single tag only) and additional pagination and ordering options. Use the 'format' parameter to choose the response format. The 'fullcount' flag can be enabled for pagination but may impact performance.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wraps the JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with JSON format on GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 10, max 200. The keyword 'all' is treated as 200.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by the queried field(s). Append _asc or _desc to specify direction; _asc is default except for popularity fields which default to _desc.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, the response header includes 'results_fullcount' – the total number of rows without pagination. Use sparingly as it may affect performance.

parameters.name: namesearch
parameters.description: Search an artist by name using wildcard matching.

parameters.name: hasimage
parameters.description: Return only artists that have an image.

parameters.name: datebetween
parameters.description: Filter on artist joining date. Format: yyyy-mm-dd_yyyy-mm-dd (from_to). Both dates mandatory.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Filter artists by a single tag. Results are returned by relevance unless a different order is specified.

responseFields.name: headers
responseFields.description: Metadata about the request, including status, code, error_message, warnings, and results_count.

responseFields.name: results
responseFields.description: Array of artist objects containing id, name, website, joindate, image, shorturl, shareurl, etc.

notes: The 'tag' parameter currently accepts only a single tag.
Ordering fields can be suffixed with _asc or _desc; popularity_* fields default to descending order.
Enabling 'fullcount' may increase response time on heavy queries.
The 'callback' parameter works only with JSON formats and GET requests; it is ignored otherwise.
